text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Three years have passed since I began
running through the Twinkle Series with Sakura Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, Laurel, are you by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Trainer has things to do until the evening today,
so I was thinking of doing some self-training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wanna run with me then?
To get ourselves hyped up for the spring GⅠ series!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahhh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Found you, Laurel-san!
Geez!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Why'd you go and win the Arima Kinen too?!
Maya had already decided she was gonna win that race...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Sorry.
But victory is going to be mine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Even you wouldn't want a first-place finish that was handed to you, right, Maya-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thaaat is truuue!
But...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Laurel-san isn't just sparkling...
She's glaring way too intensely!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm locking onto you for the next Tenno Sho (Spring).
There's no way, no way I'm letting you get away!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Whoa... That sounds tough.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that's fine.
I'll seize victory next time too!”

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Me too!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Laurel! Mayano isn't the only one☆
I'm gonna be Marvelous with you guys too★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'll catch right up to you two!
I'm coming right now!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yeah♪
Mave-chan is waiting too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Haha.
Waiting, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...? Hishi Ama-chan?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No, I just figured that wherever you guys gather,
there must be a crazy race going down.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, going back to what I suggested earlier.
Why don't Mayano and the others run alongside as well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay♪
I won't lose, even against Hishiama-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "It's rare to see you in the audience."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Because those noisy bastards
are still out on the track.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh my...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian. As friends, you don't need to hesitate to ask, "Can I join?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: How old am I in your memories?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To me, you will always be
"Narita Brian."
A strong and unyielding Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That said, I am truly delighted to see you
forge friendships your older sister knows nothing of.
And so, I shall take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: See you around, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Brian-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
! Laurel...?
Weren't you supposed to be on the track...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I caught sight of you, Brian-chan.
I wanted to talk a bit...
so I came running over!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You know... Maya-chan and I
might run in the upcoming Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...! Caught your interest?
Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then while I'm at it, let me ask this too!
Have you given any thought to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......Who knows.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Geez... You always dodge the topic
whenever it comes to this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
By the way, where is your Trainer?
I haven't seen them around for a while.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did I not tell you, Brian-chan?
Actually, right now—

text_block_list.name: Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
The Japan Cup, the Arima Kinen...
You had a truly spectacular run of achievements last year, didn't you?
choice_data_list: Likewise, thank you for everything you've done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take out the materials borrowed from
the Victory Club before and gently hand them to him.

text_block_list.name: Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I have indeed received it.
............

text_block_list.name: Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...I'm really glad that you're
Laurel's Trainer.
choice_data_list: I'd be glad if you felt that way.

text_block_list.name: Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I truly mean that
from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
For protecting Laurel's dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Welcome back, Trainer!
Perfect timing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Shall we have a quick meeting right here?
I'd like to talk about your next race rotation.
choice_data_list: I bet there's another race you want to run in, isn't there?
I bet there's another race you want to run in, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
I have even more things to look forward to now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hurry, hurry!
Let's head to the Trainer's room♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Lightly, softly, the cherry blossoms dance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Her season has only just begun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaahhh—...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Living up to her title as the race favorite,
Sakura Laurel captures a brilliant victory! She has conquered the Prix Foy!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Come now, we can't head back home just yet, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
We've earned our ticket to the world stage.
So let's see our dream through to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Our most cherished dream...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The story of the cherry blossom blooming across the world will continue.
Toward an unseen, extraordinary future—
